_about: Generated projection of the delivery-1 catalog for offline use by the crecs-property-template scripts. Do not edit; regenerate with tools/crecs-template-studio/build-references.js.
common_controls_note: Controls every widget receives from Elementor core, Elementor Pro, Premium Addons for Elementor and Header Footer Elementor. Measured, not guessed: crecs_property_meta_tags declares no controls of its own, so its stack is exactly this baseline. A key listed here is valid on any widget; the owner tells you which plugin has to be installed for it to do anything.

button.note: Carries flyer_url through crecs-property on its `link` control (URL category), and Elementor Pro popup bindings on the same control.
button.title: Button

heading.note: Carries scalar property values through the crecs-property dynamic tag on its `title` control (TEXT category).
heading.title: Heading

editor.default: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo.

crecs-test.reason: Offers every $_SERVER key as param_name and echoes the value unescaped on the public front end. It is registered and sits in the same crecs-tags group as crecs-property.

option_contract.dynamic_reason: The dropdown is rebuilt per editor load from the property held in the PHP session, and only non-empty scalar keys survive the filter. Two properties of different types therefore expose different subsets of this universe. Treat the list below as the universe, never as a fixed enum.
option_contract.option_filter: value !== null && ( is_string( value ) || is_numeric( value ) )

crecs-property.settings_encoding: Elementor serialises a tag instance into the __dynamic__ map of the host control as [elementor-tag id="<8-hex>" name="<tag name>" settings="<rawurlencoded JSON>"]. The JSON for crecs-property is {"param_name":"<key>"}.
crecs-property.title: Property Data

crecs-test.settings_encoding: Elementor serialises a tag instance into the __dynamic__ map of the host control as [elementor-tag id="<8-hex>" name="<tag name>" settings="<rawurlencoded JSON>"]. The JSON for crecs-property is {"param_name":"<key>"}.
crecs-test.title: Test Text

popup.note: Elementor Pro action-link tag. Its payload is {"popup":"<post id>"}; the id is site-specific and must come from the target profile.

premium_eq_height_update.label: Update changes to page

crecs_property_attachments.note: On this widget card_body_color is the link TEXT colour (selector .crecs-card-body ul li a), not a background. On most other widgets card_body_color is a background.

crecs_property_demographic.note: A COLOR control literally named after typography, labelled "Text Color". It collides in prefix space with the widget's typography group, which expands to card_header_typography_*. Every sibling widget calls this card_header_text_color.
A text colour named ..._color; crecs_property_traffic names the equivalent table_body_text_color.

crecs_property_field.note: The file exists but is absent from the $widgets map in includes/class-elementor-crecs-load-widgets.php, so it is never registered. It also returns the category cre-cloud-solutions-property, which the plugin never creates.

crecs_property_fields_and_data.note: Documented in the data dictionary as a possibly separate widget. The string appears nowhere in the codebase; the editor title is "CRECS: Property Fields & Data", which is where the confusion comes from.

responsive.rule: Elementor 4.2.1 with duplication mode "off" registers a responsive control ONCE, flagged is_responsive, and the editor JS creates the per-device duplicates. A "<control>_tablet" / "<control>_mobile" settings key is therefore valid if and only if that control carries is_responsive:true below. Do not synthesise device variants for any other control.
